veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Wol en koring en water is
veranderings.rede: A list of three reads more naturally with a comma than with a repeated 'en'.
A comma after the long fronted relative clause marks where the subject phrase ends and makes the sentence easier to read.

veranderings.blok: Waarde en prys is nie dieselfde nie
veranderings.na: as vir iemand wat by 'n kraan staan
veranderings.rede: Completes the parallel with 'iemand wat ver geloop het' so the comparison reads smoothly.
'Brei' is the standard Afrikaans verb for knitting; 'strik' in this sense is more regional.
AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.na: die koring waarmee alles begin het
veranderings.rede: The subjectless passive 'waarmee begin is' is wooden; an active form reads naturally and echoes the first block.

veranderings.blok: Waarom party hulpbronne meer werd is
veranderings.voor: 'n Hulpbron wat ver moes kom is hier meer werd as waar dit uitgehaal is
veranderings.na: 'n Hulpbron wat van ver af moes kom, is hier meer werd as daar waar dit uitgehaal is
veranderings.rede: Adds the comma after the fronted relative clause, uses the idiomatic 'van ver af', and gives the comparison a proper second term ('daar waar').
With 'in die een jaar' just before, the definite article reads more naturally: the harvest of that year.
The second clause still belongs to the 'dan' main clause, so it keeps the inverted verb-subject order.

vlae.blok: Waarom party hulpbronne meer werd is
vlae.rede: 'Hier' has no clear reference point for the learner (here where it is sold or used?); clarifying it would mean guessing the intended wording, so it is flagged rather than changed.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: 'n Vervaardigde goed is meestal meer werd as die grondstof
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: 'Goed' as a countable singular ('n vervaardigde goed') is unusual in Afrikaans, which normally says 'goedere' or ''n vervaardigde produk'; a person may want to check that this protected wording is what was intended.
